definitions.pair_selection: Read sealed geometry-only pairs verbatim; labels, margins, noise and eligibility do not select or replace pairs.
definitions.noise: Sequential independent source draws; episode difference variance is s_i^2+s_j^2 and label mean difference variance is s_i^2/n_i+s_j^2/n_j. No row-aligned CRN pairs exist.
definitions.labels: Same unused two repeats at held positions0..12 and all three at13..15 as Stage58, at both prefixes.
definitions.leave_one: Delete one repeat at one endpoint, leave the other endpoint intact. Record all n_i+n_j signs; no stability threshold filters pairs.
definitions.mixed_unobserved_relative_optimism: For observed i and unobserved j, (predicted f_i-f_j)-(unused-label f_i-f_j); positive means unobserved j is relatively optimistic.
definitions.empirical_feasibility: Unused constraint mean + normal quantile times sample standard deviation <=0, never a chance-feasibility certificate.
definitions.eligibility: Saved source terminal probability_violation <=0.5. Applying this criterion to unobserved points is diagnostic; the actual saved terminal13 considered observed13 only.
definitions.statistical_unit: Within-group pair metrics before descriptive means across24 overlapping archive/fold/family groups; pairs are not independent task replications.

limits: Two or three source scoring repeats are noisy labels. Leave-one sign stability is descriptive, not an objective-order certificate.
Source marginal moments cannot reconstruct target acquisition sampled margins, cross-policy posterior covariance or sampling-temperature effects.
No source or target means, thresholds, weights, search or terminal rules are changed; no minimal correction is preselected.
